plugin_assistant.title: AI Assistant
plugin_assistant.description: Keep up to 30 personal named conversations, each retaining the latest 6 successful turns within 12 KiB. Legacy sessions remain cached for 30 minutes. Marking messages read requires password confirmation and Continue; pending confirmations expire.

conversations.name: Conversation name (up to 80 characters)
conversations.confirmDelete: Permanently delete this conversation and its retained turns?
conversations.error: Conversation list or change unavailable. Refresh and check the 30-conversation limit, name length, active run, and database migration setup.

plugin_assistant.input: Enter a message, e.g. How many unread messages do I have?
plugin_assistant.empty: Start a conversation. Only successfully completed turns enter history.
plugin_assistant.disabled: AI is disabled or unavailable for this tenant. Ask an administrator to check AI settings.
plugin_assistant.error: The request did not complete. Refresh to check the session before resending to avoid duplicate charges.

confirmation.title: Write confirmation
confirmation.instructions: Open the confirmation page, confirm with your password, then return and select Continue. Returning alone does not execute the write.
confirmation.expired: Confirmation expired. Clear the conversation or send a new request when available.
confirmation.invalid: Confirmation data is invalid. Refresh or clear the conversation.
confirmation.permission: Opening confirmations and continuing requires mcp:list permission.
confirmation.pending: Approval is pending or the conversation changed. Refresh and complete password confirmation before continuing.
